item.title: Self-Hosted Farm Management Software: farmOS vs Tania vs LiteFarm
item.description: Managing a small farm, community garden, or homestead involves tracking planting schedules, harvests, livestock, soil conditions, and inventory — all while staying on top of regulatory compliance and organic certification. While commercial farm management suites like Granular and Climate FieldView carry enterprise price tags, several powerful open-source alternatives let you self-host your farm data on your own server.
